ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; the driver cancelled-by-rider claim fails — the driver never tapped "I'm Here" and at the moment of cancellation was ~2.5 km from Bedok Mall, so no no-show fee was chargeable.
ruling.reasoning: Dispute type is no_show but the record shows the RIDER cancelled at 17:15:05 (trip.cancelled_by = "rider"), so NS-0 routes the case to NS-4 (on-demand, rider cancellation). Acceptance was 17:12:00, cancellation 17:15:05 → 3 min 5 s after matching, i.e. more than 3:00 (NS-4 threshold), so on the face of the timestamps the $6.61 fee is chargeable. However, the record contains no driver-side no-show elements at all: driver_arrived_at, driver_pressed_here_at, arrival_confirmed_by, wait_started_at and wait_expired_at are all null, and the driver's own statement says only "the rider cancelled while I was still on the way" — the driver never pressed "I'm Here" and never claimed a rider no-show. The GPS trace confirms this: at 17:12:00 the driver was at (1.31786, 103.90733), ~2.5 km from Bedok Mall, and at 17:15:05 he was at (1.32108, 103.91456), still ~1.8–2.2 km away and moving away along Sims Avenue East; he was never within the 200 m arrival radius. NS-3 therefore governs: the fee is a driver-side or unmatched-cancellation situation in which the passenger bears no $6.61; the rider's complaint ("driver was still far away after more than 3 minutes") is corroborated by the GPS, and the chat ("Are you near?" / driver: "Coming, about 5 min") is consistent, the driver being ~5 km away at 17:13:15. No ETA-based free-cancellation rule exists in Ryde policy (NS-8 is informational only, G7), but NS-3 suffices here. Amount = full cancellation fee $6.61 → refund_full. The driver's unsubstantiated fee retention is not an abuse-of-cancellation-button case (he did not tap "I'm Here" away from the pickup), so no flag_account. Note on evidence: the GPS provided is thinned to every 6th sample on a 30 s grid — not a gap under the G12 definition (30 s is the stated grid, far under 2 min) — and the cancellation time is corroborated by both timeline and driver statement, so no material record is missing; evidence_status = sufficient.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver never pressed "I'm Here" (driver_pressed_here_at is null), was ~2.5 km from Bedok Mall at acceptance and still ~1.8 km away at cancellation per GPS, and did not claim a rider no-show — NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) all fail, so no no-show fee can stand.

The 3:05 post-match cancellation would ordinarily support the fee under NS-4, but NS-0/NS-3 control because the record shows no valid no-show basis and the driver's GPS position confirms the rider's account that the driver was still far away.
